messages:
jordan: Heads-up — noticed a spike in token-level 95p latency on EU->US fallbacks this morning, correlates with a higher KV cache miss split. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/ops/kv-routing-token-breakdown :eyes:
priya: Can you paste the query/filters? I want to see kernel tags + route tags together.
sasha: I saw this too, 95p token latency jumped from ~22ms -> ~48ms for requests that routed cross-region and hit fallback model variants. Low-level profile shows more kernel switches mid-sequence.
jordan: Filter: env=prod, route=chat-complete, region=eu-west, routing.outcome=fallback; group by kernel_selector, kv_hit, token_index_bin. Link: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/ops/query/1805?params=kv+split
kevin: Quick note: fallback variants are lower-quantized models and use the legacy matmul kernel (matmul_v1) until we hit the newer kernel selector path. That kernel has higher per-token tail latency on short sequences.
priya: That explains the kernel_switch count. Are we measuring kernel selection changes as a dimension in token-level traces currently?
perf-bot: automated-profile: trace_id=tr-1805012345-01; reason=high-95p; tags=[route:chat-complete, outcome:fallback, kernel_span:2, kv_miss:true]
sasha: We have kernel_switches instrumented but not exposed in the token breakdown dashboard. Right now token breakdown panels only show total token latency + kv_hit rate. Need kernel_name + kernel_version + batch_size at token time.
jordan: Proposed quick instrumentation: add labels kernel_name, kernel_variant, batch_window_ms, kv_cached (true/false), and region_route (src->dst) to token telemetry. Minimal change: inject labels at runtime in token telemetry emitter.
kevin: Also add a small histogram for kernel_switch_count per request and token_index_of_first_switch. Should make it easy to see mid-sequence switches that trigger slow kernels.
priya: For dashboards: panel ideas — 1) token latency heatmap by token_index_bin x kernel_variant (percentile lines), 2) route-level fallback-rate vs cross-region latency, 3) KV-split waterfall (prefix-hit, kv-prefetch, miss) per route.
sasha: I prototyped a token_index_bin of [0-8,9-32,33-128,>128] and it revealed that most slow fallbacks happen in 9-32 bin (warm KV cache but kernel switch after prefix).
jordan: Numbers from 06:12-06:40 UTC: fallback_rate eu-west -> us-east = 0.8% (baseline 0.15%), avg 95p token latency for fallback requests = 46ms, non-fallback = 20ms. KV_miss rate for those = 62%.
kevin: Root cause hypothesis: routing fallback sends compatible smaller-quantized variant that triggers kernel_selector to downgrade to matmul_v1, and because batching windows differ for fallbacks we often get tiny batches -> high per-token overhead.
priya: Action items: (A) eng-runtime to add kernel_name/variant labels to token telemetry (owner: kevin, due EOD PST) (B) eng-platform to add dashboard panels + alert for fallback_rate > 0.5% (owner: sasha, due tomorrow) (C) eng-ml to validate kernel feature parity for quantized variants (owner: priya, ETA 48h).
kevin: I'll open a draft PR to add the labels and a low-overhead enum encoding for kernel_variant. Will also emit kernel_switch_count.
sasha: I'll add the dashboard panels and a simple alert rule: region_fallback_rate > 0.5% sustained 10m -> pager to oncall.
jordan: Meanwhile can we throttle cross-region routing to reduce immediate user impact? Maybe enable stronger local-first policy for EU routes for next hour? @sasha?
sasha: I can flip routing policy to prefer local-capacity for chat-complete for 30m. Doing a small canary now.
perf-bot: deploy-notice: routing-policy change by sasha at 1805012358, change_id=rp-789.
priya: After kevin's labels are in, we should run a profiling job sampling 1% of fallback requests with Nsight/ptop to capture kernel timelines. Add sampling tag sample=kernel-capture.
kevin: Agree. I'll add sampling flag in the PR behind feature flag.
jordan: Good. After we have data, decide whether to (1) backport new matmul kernel optimizations to legacy path, (2) change fallback model variant compatibility so kernel_selector stays on modern path, or (3) tweak batching heuristic to avoid tiny batches on fallbacks.
sasha: I'll follow up with oncall if the temporary routing flip doesn't reduce 95p by next 10m. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
priya: Thanks — will sync in 2 hours. If anyone finds immediate regressions post-change, ping here and escalate. :thumbsup:
